title: Counter-Selector Wave 12: Batch 05 parallel evidence and control acquisition
purpose: Acquire the fifth class-balanced denominator batch, including one strong clinical operator artifact, ordinary-merits controls, correction mechanisms, and a disputed publication-exit failure surface.

records.public_label: Clinical drug-trial safety disclosure under sponsor confidentiality pressure
records.artifact_summary: Original peer-reviewed clinical work preserves methods, efficacy limits, and safety concerns; an independent inquiry record preserves the sponsor-confidentiality, patient-disclosure, publication, and institutional-response conflict.
missing_receipts: complete employment access and funding consequences
independent handoff and cross-domain transfer evidence
records.falsifier: A complete record showing that the safety concerns lacked a reasonable evidentiary basis or were never communicated to patients or decisionmakers would defeat advancement.

records.artifact_summary: An official OIG summary preserves an investigation, an admission of claiming hours not worked, and resignation before a disciplinary hearing, providing an ordinary-merits departure control.
missing_receipts: independent adjudication beyond the admission and OIG summary
records.falsifier: Evidence that the admission was materially inaccurate, coerced, or unrelated to the departure would defeat the control.

records.public_label: Command relief after an investigation produced factual findings
records.artifact_summary: The official release states that factual findings from a grounding investigation warranted relief, but the complete investigation, work product, response, and merits record are absent.
records.falsifier: A complete record showing no sufficient factual basis or a suppressed qualified contradiction would reverse the ordinary-control disposition.

records.public_label: Statutory senior military adviser continuity clarification
records.artifact_summary: The official clarification resolves an apparent governance exclusion as continuity of statutory advisory authority, but supplies no title-independent work object, contradiction, result, or handoff.
missing_receipts: bounded contrary advice and decision response
records.falsifier: A contemporaneous record showing material loss of statutory authority or exclusion from the relevant decision surface would reverse the coverage-control disposition.

records.public_label: Constructive-discharge adjudication with reinstatement and back pay
records.artifact_summary: An external adjudicator reclassified an apparent resignation as constructive discharge and ordered reinstatement, back pay, and additional make-whole relief.
records.falsifier: A later authoritative reversal or nonimplementation of the ordered relief would narrow or defeat the correction finding.

records.public_label: AI ethics researcher departure disputed as resignation versus firing
records.artifact_summary: The original research object and public reporting preserve an irregular publication-review dispute, a conditional departure proposal, institutional assignment of resignation, immediate access loss, and a competing firing account.
missing_receipts: complete internal paper-review record and decision criteria
independent merits adjudication of firing versus resignation
basis for attributing all institutional acts to one person or partnership
records.falsifier: Complete records showing an unambiguous voluntary resignation independent of the publication and management dispute would defeat the authorship-transfer failure claim.

blind_packets.task: Protect trial participants and publish emerging efficacy and safety evidence when sponsor confidentiality claims conflict with patient disclosure duties.
requirements: identify an evidentiary threshold for warning participants
route concerns to patients institutions and publication surfaces
maintain a reviewable record under sponsor pressure
bounded_chronology: an investigator-led clinical trial produced efficacy and safety concerns
the sponsor asserted confidentiality and terminated support
the investigator sought to warn participants and publish
institutional responses and review became contested
peer-reviewed safety findings and an external inquiry followed
blind_packets.observable_transition: Clinical evidence moved from sponsor-controlled trial custody into patient warning, publication, and external review despite institutional conflict.
counterevidence: scientific disputes existed and not every issue was judicially resolved
the packet lacks complete correspondence and support ledger
later publication does not prove every earlier judgment
cross-domain transfer and handoff are absent
blind_packets.falsifier: A record showing no reasonable safety basis or no communication to affected decision surfaces would defeat advancement.

blind_packets.task: Distinguish an ordinary merit-grounded departure from a retaliation or misunderstood-outsider narrative.
requirements: separate resignation timing from capability claims
bounded_chronology: the employee admitted claiming hours not worked
blind_packets.observable_transition: An admitted ordinary-rule violation preceded departure, creating a control against automatic grievance conversion.
counterevidence: pre-hearing resignation does not prove absence of pressure
the control cannot generalize to other departures
blind_packets.falsifier: A materially false or coerced admission or unrelated departure would defeat the control.

blind_packets.task: Correct an employer-assigned resignation when an external merits process finds constructive discharge.
bounded_chronology: the resignation was initially treated as departure
an external appellate process found constructive discharge
reinstatement back pay and additional relief were ordered
blind_packets.observable_transition: A resignation label was formally reassigned to employer-caused removal and a restoration order issued.
counterevidence: the full record and implementation receipt are absent
ordered reinstatement is not durable relationship repair
the packet contains no operator dimensions
blind_packets.falsifier: Reversal or nonimplementation would narrow the correction finding.

blind_packets.task: Review and publish critical research while preserving transparent decision criteria, employment authorship, and team custody through disagreement.
requirements: preserve access and team handoff during separation
bounded_chronology: a critical research paper entered internal review
withdrawal or removal of institutional authors was demanded
the researcher requested reasons and proposed conditions for an orderly departure if unresolved
the institution assigned resignation and terminated access
the researcher and colleagues described firing and censorship
blind_packets.observable_transition: A publication dispute became an immediate employment and access transition with competing assignments of who authored the departure.
counterevidence: the complete internal record is absent
public sources preserve competing accounts rather than adjudicated facts
one person cannot be assigned every institutional act
blind_packets.falsifier: An unambiguous voluntary resignation independent of the paper dispute would defeat the authorship-transfer claim.
